intro: One playthrough is enough: about 200 hours to the platinum, difficulty 4 out of 10 (PowerPyx). There are no difficulty settings, no online trophies, no mission medals and no mission replay — so keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter. Progress you make during the story already counts toward the 100% checklist, which only becomes visible after the story.
missableIntro: From the official descriptions and the published roadmaps, only one trophy is possibly missable. Everything else — story trophies included — can still be earned in free-roam after the story, because there is no mission replay but also no point of no return for trophies.

notes.body: Cheats disable trophies and saving, and only work after the story anyway — keep them off for the whole run.
notes.title: Cheats switch trophies off

notes.body: Your profile (Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, Irredeemable) only changes how police treat you. Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid endless rampages; it does not block any trophy.
notes.title: Criminal profile

notes.body: Andy's quests are Lucia-only; Tyrone's and Bret's are Jason-only. Both characters become freely switchable after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.

steps.body: Finish all five chapters and take optional missions as they appear. Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals through the binoculars as you go — both feed the 100% checklist later. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia (see Missable trophies) before Chapter 1 ends.
steps.title: Step 1 — Play the story (Chapters 1–5)

steps.body: After the story, the checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It asks for roughly 60% of true completion: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges and drone races, plus any 70 of the 80 challenges — so you can skip the hardest ten.
steps.title: Step 2 — The 100% checklist & challenges

steps.body: Finish the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands that count (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete and more), the five character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret), and whatever is left. Every trophy-related quest giver is still available after the story.
